laws.witness_or_proof: commitBatch with version v for which latestVerifier[v].verifier == address(0) (e.g. v = 0 after only v1/v2 verifiers were registered), then challengeState; proveState reverts in getVerifier / in the call to address(0); after W the challenger wins by timeout.
blob with blob[3968*32] != 0 and canonical elements 0..3967: common/blob returns an error, common/batch panics (index 126976 out of range for length 126976).
bd with len(blockContexts) > 0 and payload sized so that len(tx)+len(txsPayload) <= k*126976 < len(ctx)+len(tx)+len(txsPayload): estimate says fit, will_exceed says exceed.
incompressible x with len(x) = k*126976 - 1: fast path says fit, zstd(x) is longer than x by the frame overhead, sealing fails.
any bd with blockNum >= 1: the legacy preimage (58-byte context prefixes) differs from the on-chain preimage (8+2 bytes), so the hashes differ except on a keccak collision (excluded by CF).
payload whose contexts carry numbers parent.lbn+5 .. parent.lbn+5+count-1 with header lbn = parent.lbn+count: derivation accepts; derived first block != parent.lbn+1 and last != lbn.
